backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing user profiles and per-user file lists with access control for user and admin actions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend component, hook, utility, and page.
frontend/.env.example: Template for optional public app and Internet Identity URLs used during builds.
frontend/delivery/.gitignore: Gitignore rules excluding generated exports and ZIP files in the delivery directory.
frontend/delivery/DEPLOY_TROUBLESHOOTING: Guide detailing common deployment issues and their fixes for the Payment Tracker App.
Shell script that copies the repository into a single export folder while excluding build and dependency directories.
frontend/delivery/export-zip.sh: Shell script that stages the repository into a single folder and produces a ZIP archive excluding unwanted directories.
frontend/delivery/PROJECT_TREE.md: Document outlining the full project folder structure.
frontend/delivery/README.md: Overview of delivery tooling and instructions for generating project folder and ZIP exports.
frontend/delivery/regenerate-export.sh: Script that regenerates delivery exports and collects key frontend files for troubleshooting.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme styles defining color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Frontend entry HTML defining metadata, root mount point, favicon, and main script loader.
frontend/README.md: Frontend documentation covering setup, prerequisites, and development instructions.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling Internet Identity auth, profile fetch, and routing to login, profile setup, or main layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen UI that triggers Internet Identity authentication with feature highlights and loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting new users to enter and save their name, with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/charts/IncomeVsE: Bar chart displaying monthly income and expenses using Recharts with loading and compact modes.
frontend/src/components/disclosures/Manu: Informational banner noting that all transactions must be entered manually without bank connections.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout managing navigation between pages, monthly reminder banner, and logout flow.
frontend/src/components/month/MonthPicke: Month navigation widget allowing users to move between months and update selected month/year state.
frontend/src/components/notifications/Mo: Banner reminding users of a new month with options to view summary or dismiss.
frontend/src/components/summary/MonthlyT: Card summarizing monthly income, expenses, and balance with loading state and formatted values.
frontend/src/components/transactions/Tra: Form component for creating a transaction with validation and local add mutation.
Displays monthly transactions with loading, empty, and error states using local storage data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and updates the caller's user profile via actor-based queries and mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading, login, and logout logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useMonthlyReminder.ts: Manages per-user monthly reminder settings and tracking via localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file documenting where queries are defined.
frontend/src/hooks/useSelectedMonth.ts: Stores and persists the selected month and year in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useTransactions.ts: Handles adding, retrieving, and aggregating user transactions stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and extensive OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity context.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Renders settings UI for profile details, notifications, and app link sharing.
frontend/src/pages/SummaryPage.tsx: Displays monthly financial summary with balance, totals, and income vs expense chart.
frontend/src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx: Shows month picker, totals, chart, transaction form, and transaction list with add button.
frontend/src/types/transaction.ts: Defines transaction-related TypeScript types and enums used locally.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Provides clipboard copy utility with modern and fallback methods.
frontend/src/utils/getPublicAppUrl.ts: Returns the public app URL using env vars or window origin.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Type declarations for Vite environment variables.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending theme colors from CSS variables and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, existing features, issues, and a pending request related to producing a unified local project folder/ZIP export.
